# Repair cafe refusal explained early

A visitor brought a mains heater outside our agreed scope. We explained the refusal at the door and offered a qualified repairer contact. She was disappointed but did not spend the morning waiting. [[Repair ideas]]: a clear limit can improve the visit without producing a repair. The refusal deserves an ordinary outcome category.
